entries.summary: Four industry research programmes added and the crawler now audits pharma coverage itself, because these programmes carry no deadline and come and go.

tools/watch.py now carries a 27-company pharma and diagnostics watchlist and raises a coverage_gap signal for any company no record cites, at most once every 30 days, so a programme that appears is not missed.
